briefTitle: A Study of Tolododekin Alfa (ANK-101) in Combination With an Anti-PD-1/PD-L1 Antibody in Participants With Advanced Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer

typedChecks.sourceText: Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group performance status (ECOG PS) 0 to 1
typedChecks.evidence_quote: Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group performance status (ECOG PS) 0 to 1

typedChecks.sourceText: Have known active central nervous system metastases
typedChecks.evidence_quote: Have known active central nervous system metastases

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Have confirmed locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC is in scope, but there is no specific numbered stage list for a stage_in check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Thyroid-stimulating hormone (TSH) within normal limits
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: TSH is not a typed lab kind in the allowed list.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Have measurable disease per Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors version 1.1 (RECIST v1.1)
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Measurable disease by RECIST is a subjective imaging judgment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Have a life expectancy > 12 weeks
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Life expectancy is a subjective clinical judgment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Have baseline electrocardiogram (ECG) without evidence of acute ischemia or prolonged QT interval
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: ECG interpretation is a subjective clinical judgment, not a typed lab cutoff.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Heterosexually active women of childbearing potential (WOCBP) must agree to use highly effective methods of contraception
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Contraception compliance is a behavioral requirement, not a typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Male participants who are not sterile must commit to the use of a reliable method of birth control or abstinence
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Contraception compliance is a behavioral requirement, not a typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Human immunodeficiency virus (HIV)-infected participants must be on anti-retroviral therapy (ART) and have well-controlled HIV infection/disease
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: HIV condition management requires clinical judgment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Resolution of all prior anticancer therapy toxicities prior to C1D1.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Toxicity resolution is a clinical judgment, not a typed lab cutoff.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Willingness to provide fresh tumor biopsy specimens
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Willingness to undergo a procedure is a subjective judgment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Provides written informed consent for the study
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Informed consent is an administrative requirement, not a typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Cohort A only: Participants with toxic effects to manage adverse events from previous treatment with immunotherapy
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Cohort-specific toxicity rules are conditional and subjective.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Cohort B only: Prior therapy with an immune checkpoint inhibitor.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Cohort-specific prior therapy exclusion is conditional.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Have received short-term systemic therapy with immunosuppressive agents prior to C1D1
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Immune suppressive therapy history is a complex clinical rule without a specific typed kind.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Have active autoimmune disease or medical conditions requiring chronic steroid or other immunosuppressive therapy prior to C1D1
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Autoimmune disease and steroid requirements involve clinical judgment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Have received live vaccines prior to C1D1
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Live vaccine history is not a typed prior therapy check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Have primary or acquired immunodeficient states
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Immunodeficient state assessment is a clinical judgment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Female participant who is pregnant or breastfeeding
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Pregnancy/breastfeeding status is a clinical condition, not a typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Have a history of allogeneic tissue/solid organ transplant
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Transplant history is not a typed prior therapy or medical condition check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Has active hepatitis B virus (HBV) or hepatitis C virus (HCV).
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Active viral hepatitis is an infection status, not a typed lab cutoff.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: HIV-infected participants with a history of Kaposi sarcoma and/or Multicentric Castleman Disease
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Specific HIV complications are complex clinical exclusions.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Have congestive heart failure, active coronary artery disease, unevaluated new onset angina, unstable angina, or clinically significant cardiac arrhythmias.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Cardiac conditions require subjective investigator evaluation.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Have uncontrolled bleeding disorders prior to C1D1
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Bleeding disorders assessment is a clinical judgment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants on coumadin (warfarin), due to potential for increased bleeding risk associated with surgery
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Medication exclusion for warfarin is not a typed prior_therapy_excluded check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: History of noninfectious pneumonitis
